indication_area: Oncology (advanced renal cell carcinoma, soft tissue sarcoma)

launch_evidence.quote: In the last two weeks, we have received US approvals for Cervarix, Votrient and Arzerra.

series_start_reason: FDA approval 19 Oct 2009 (2009Q4). GSK's Q4 2009 announcement (0000950123-10-008661) prints no Votrient turnover row; the first row is Q1 2010 (5). No GSK document states a launch date in words; launch_quarter is the US approval quarter, one quarter before the first printed row.
series_end_reason: From the Q1 2024 interim report (6-K 0001370368-24-000017) Novartis prints no Votrient row (Oncology table: Kisqali, Promacta/Revolade, Jakavi, Tafinlar + Mekinist, Tasigna, Pluvicto, Lutathera, Scemblix, Kymriah, Piqray/Vijoice, Fabhalta, Other). The Q4 2023 report is the last (77; FY 2023 390).

unreported_quarters.2015Q1: Ownership change GSK plc to Novartis; no full-quarter figure is published. Novartis acquired GSK's oncology business on 2 March 2015 and its Q1 2015 report (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1114448/000137036815000043/a150423-99_2.htm) prints 'Votrient 1 | 57' with the footnote 'Products acquired in GSK transaction, only March sales included'; GSK's Q1 2015 announcement (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1131399/000119163815000622/gsk201505066k.htm) prints only a two-month oncology total and no Votrient row.

reviewed_anomalies.2015Q2: Issuer and reporting-currency step: 2010Q1-2014Q4 are GSK plc's Votrient turnover in GBP millions; from 2015Q2 Novartis reports the same worldwide product in USD millions. Rows carry their own currency and are not converted.

notes: GSK plc worldwide turnover in GBP millions, Total column of the quarterly Pharmaceuticals turnover table (the same row prints USA, Europe and other-region columns). From 2015Q2: Novartis worldwide net sales in USD millions.
search_log: Listed GSK plc (CIK 1131399) filings via data.sec.gov submissions (6,852 filings, 6,139 of them 6-K); located the quarterly results announcements with EDGAR full-text search for 'Tykerb', 'Votrient' and 'Arzerra' (6-K hits 2007-2015 in the results windows; 39 documents fetched).

The quarter's figure is read from the Pharmaceuticals turnover table headed 'Three months ended ...' (the cumulative 'Six/Nine months ended' and 'Year ended' tables are skipped); the period comes from that heading. Re-filed copies (2008-05-06, 2012-05-02) are not cited; the earlier filing is.

GSK's Q1 2015 results announcement (6-K 0001191638-15-000622, gsk201505066k.htm) prints no oncology brand rows: 'Oncology sales for the first two months were £216 million', after the disposal of the oncology business to Novartis on 2 March 2015.

Listed Novartis AG (CIK 1114448) filings via data.sec.gov submissions (recent plus older pages, all form types: 1,431 filings, 937 of them 6-K). Located quarterly results documents with EDGAR full-text search (efts.sec.gov) for each brand name (Exjade, Afinitor, Jadenu, Fabhalta, Piqray, Vijoice, Votrient, Tykerb, Arzerra, Signifor) over 2005-2026, restricted to 6-K hits filed in the results windows (Jan-Feb, Apr-May, Jul-Aug, Oct-Nov); 199 documents fetched (6-K bodies 2005-2011, EX-99.1/EX-99.2 from 2010). The union contains every quarterly report 2005Q4-2026Q3, since each prints an Exjade or Afinitor or Piqray row.

Rows extracted by script from every HTML table whose header row begins with 'Qn YYYY' (the quarter table), taking the row whose first cell starts with the brand; the first figure is the current quarter. Where two filings carry the same quarter (2010-2012 duplicates under accession prefixes 0001104659 and 0001370368) the EX-99.2 interim financial report or the 0001370368 filing is cited.

Votrient checks: GSK years as in gsk_votrient; Novartis 2015 57+165+167+176 = 565 (FY 2015 column 565, Q1 being March only), 2016 729, 2017 808, 2018 828, 2019 755, 2020 635, 2021 577, 2022 474, 2023 390, each equal to the FY column.
